audit_role: independent source auditor of exact full-iteration-04 snapshot
verdict_scope: Source-supported fidelity only; not unconditional playable-core completeness.

scope.included: Original Nemesis standard semi-cooperative core, basic board, six original characters; official FAQ v2.2 dated 16.04.2025, base Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items printed pp.2–4.
excluded: Solo/fully cooperative variants, including FAQ Rules 17–18
All expansion FAQ sections printed pp.5–6

method.source_recheck: The complete scoped original manual and FAQ are retained from direct source reads in this auditor context. Current snapshot was read in full and evaluated afresh; focused original-PDF rechecks covered discard/phase/victory/Action/Injury/Room pages, plus a fresh scoped FAQ read. Printed die/cost/crafting icons and PDF-only Search notes were previously inspected directly from these same allowed authoritative PDFs and used to assess the current tables.

Four expressly unresolved source cases remain disclosed, with no supplied resolution silently invented; printed card dependencies and excluded game modes/expansions remain explicit.

source_limitations.case: Required Adult placement with all eight models already in Combat
source_references: Original manual p.15, Additional notes about Intruder movement
source_limitations.assessment: The remedy removes noncombat Adults only; no alternative model-supply rule is provided for this state. Summary accurately leaves it unresolved.

source_limitations.case: Queen development adds an Egg after Nest was marked destroyed
source_limitations.assessment: The sources do not expressly reconcile the added Egg with the destroyed-Nest marker/status. Summary accurately discloses that limit.

source_limitations.case: Contamination on a successful Egg Melee
source_references: Original manual pp.19,25, Melee and Destroying Eggs
source_limitations.assessment: The exception ends with if they miss; its grammar does not uniquely settle the Contamination exemption on a hit. The missed-attack exemption is correctly stated and the successful case remains disclosed.

source_limitations.case: Later death after pods were re-locked following first-death unlock
source_references: Original manual p.12, First dead Character
source_limitations.assessment: Manual first-death and any-death wording conflict. FAQ 25 addresses later yellow spaces, not later deaths. Summary states first-death procedure and separately flags the unresolved conflict.

These sources provide examples and FAQ corrections, not every individual Action, Item, Objective, Serious Wound, Weakness or character-specific effect. Summary retains component dependencies; a source-text audit does not certify a standalone replacement for those cards.

source_supported_fidelity.explanation: The exact iteration-04 snapshot preserves source-supported procedures and exceptions. The new discard, die, scan and endgame tables agree with their governing rules and the rest of the summary; Destination mapping, hibernation restrictions and Fire Injury checks are supported. No actionable source-supported correction was identified.

complete_core.explanation: Four explicitly disclosed reachable cases lack a unique authoritative resolution in the supplied manual/FAQ, and the reference still relies on physical component text. A fidelity PASS does not establish a unique rule for every possible core state or replace all card text. These limitations must not be reclassified as summary omissions of an available authoritative answer.

overall_conclusion: PASS for source-supported fidelity of this exact snapshot. Complete-core certification remains conditional and incomplete for the listed source limitations.
